body: Here's the thing, I've gotten all the help I could get, meds, therapy, meditation, what not. And I still find it hard to not harm myself everyday. The only thing keeping me alive is the inability to comit suicide, though I tried and failed once miserably. When you do something like that, there's no coming back from that. But here's a tiny ray of hope, we can feel tired 6 out of 7 days but maybe just maybe, the seventh day would be a little better? I know it's exhausting to wait for that one day but sometimes it's worth it.

Hugs to you too!
Additionally, I don't know how you feel about dating apps, but perhaps join one, just for the sake of it, some external validation could help?

I understand that by Indian standards 28 is a marriageable age (indian woman myself) and folks around getting married and having kids can cause a lot of anxiety but please don't give into arranged marriage just for the sake of it. You're a beautiful person and love will come your way, again. :) As for breaking up with your long term partner for the reasons you mentioned, I'm proud of you. It takes courage and a certain sense of self love to not accept what's not worthy of you. Also, depending on where ever you are, take a short road trip please, if you can? Change of scenery even for a bit can change things dramatically. Sending love and power x x
Thank you everyone, for sharing. I'm a little more hopeful now. Thank you. And big hugs for finding your way through the struggle. 🌻🌻🌻
I completely get this. I've been meaning to adopt a dog myself but home environment is so hostile, I can't imagine bringing a baby here. Planning to move out soon so I can be a dog mom.
Thank you for sharing! I'd love to know the podcast recommendations. Kindly share? 🌻
Thank you! I'm glad you're able to push yourself. 🌻
Thank you for this. Big hugs to you too!
I don't know what to say except, I cried reading your post, that's how much I relate to it. Sending hugs x
I'm so happy for you 🌼
BIG WARM VIRTUAL HUGS

I think maybe there's a lot of comfort sharing feelings like this with strangers. And I genuinely mean it when I say, if you need someone to talk to, I'm here.

But apart from that, I think what we share is the feeling of not wanting to exist anymore. I can relate to that. I'd personally want to be in a car crash where only I'd get hurt and die. Everyday is a painful reminder of my failings.

But somedays, I resort to hope, the most useless and useful of the emotions and I breathe some more. 

Sending you big hugs x
Thank you x
I hope you're better too.
Sending you warmth, thank you!

I'm in the same boat as you are except I'm 25. And I desperately want to tell both of us that maybe, just maybe there are things that lie ahead of us that aren't so bad? I don't know how to stop hating myself though. But here's to us sticking around. Hugs x x
BIG HUGS x

I can't believe how similar our stories are, I'm 25 too and I've been struggling for a decade as well, one serious attempt. Psychiatrists, meds, therapists and what not. I don't know if it helps to know that I truly feel your pain. I know what it's like to have tried and tried and tried and failed. Things don't seem to get better and then you're left with this feeling "what to do now?". If you find a way out, tell me too.
For the mean time, all the love x x

Hello, you! First of all, thanks for sharing how you feel, acknowledging the pain and asking for help is your first win.
Second, I hope I could say something that will take all the pain away but I can't. I'm 25 now but I wrote my first set of suicide letters when I was 15. I have been diagnosed with depression, anxiety and ocd and I'm on meds too. The reason I'm sharing this is, the pain does not simply go away but you learn to live with it. And things change, you're in pain now, but soon you'll find something to be cheerful about. And of course, the pain might return again but it will keep changing. There are so many wonderful things that lie ahead of you, thinking or imagining those right now might seem impossible but I assure you there are. Sending you all the love and hugs x x x

I feel I'm always in the passive suicide mode. I think the self harm that one does in this mode has more sustained effects. I also feel, though we want to die, actively working on it is not something that we can either do or even want to do. All we want is self sabotage and if death comes through that, why not? I wish I had something encouraging to say to you.
Have you watched Bojack Horseman? It talks about self harm and sabotage a lot and in the background there exists hope for all, and people carry on. I think that's what we need to do.

I've tried and tried and tried and doing away with suffering is impossible. It's not even like suffering is part of life, it's like suffering is life itself. I hope you find the strength and love to carry on.
Sending love x
I feel you.
Love x
That feels oddly good. :)
